plan.candidate: same source + SYNC_IOC_SET_DEADLINE at submit + 50 ms
plan.primary: paired mean of all 100 wake frames; withhold uncensored estimate if any window is censored
plan.secondary: paired mean of all 100 baseline frames, only if all baseline windows complete

plan.validation: 32 recurrent reference frames per variant, Android unit tests, diagnostic pair verifying deadline ioctl results before untraced controls
